instruction: Change the default font to Courier New for all newly created documents in LibreOffice Writer

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing the default font for LibreOffice Writer to Courier New. The evaluator checks the LibreOffice configuration file (registrymodifications.xcu) to verify that the Standard font setting under DefaultFont is set to 'Courier New'. Nearly identical pattern to original task which sets Times New Roman.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic is semantically and logically correct for verifying the instruction
Getter correctly fetches the LibreOffice configuration file (registrymodifications.xcu) where default font settings are stored
Metric function correctly parses XML and searches for the Standard font setting under /org.openoffice.Office.Writer/DefaultFont
Expected value 'Courier New' matches the instruction requirement
Complete coverage: evaluator checks the single requirement in the instruction
Parameter handling is correct: metric directly accesses rules['font_name'] (no type='rule' errors)
No postconfig needed since configuration file is persistent
Data flow is correct: file fetch → XML parse → font extraction → comparison with expected value
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Error handling uses broad 'except Exception' which could be more specific (e.g., separate FileNotFoundError, ParseError)
Minor: Return value of 0 doesn't distinguish between 'file not found' vs 'wrong font set' (acceptable for binary pass/fail but could be more granular)
